correctness.rationale: Every hypotheses and normalization stated explicitly. The unitary two-subspace Gram block yields eigenvalue pairing and positivity; the Laguerre matrix formula is direct from the Weyl operator. Each exterior-power matrix of order \(r\) has exactly one minimal-exponent minor of order \(r\), of degree \(r^2\) with nonzero reciprocal-factorial Vandermonde constant \(D_{m,r}\); norm convergence of Fock power series makes all other minors one order higher, hence singular values have orders \(2r-1\) and Gram lower eigenvalues orders \(4r-2\). The worst-case factorial identity was checked symbolically for \(m\le6\) and proved by cancellation for all m. 139 finite assertions support, but do not substitute for, the infinite argument.

value.rationale: Collision of Hermite sampling sites is a fundamental stability boundary in multiple interpolation, but general density/separation existence theorems do not quantify conditioning. The finding classifies the entire full-dimensional degenerating Gram spectrum (not merely a small example), gives exact all-channel exponents and positive factorial constants for each multiplicity, and supplies the sharp interpolation condition-number divergence. The distinction of m independent singular scales is structural and useful in resolving which derivative combinations become ill-conditioned.
